messages:
alex: Quick follow-up from yesterday's KV OOM postmortem — collecting owners & timelines for remediation. Summary: profiling pointed to shard allocator fragmentation + small persistent allocations in kv::cache; GC/tracking needed; short-term guardrails before full fix. Need owners for profiling, tests, GC tuning, limits, rollout.

maria: can you drop the postmortem link? I want to add infra notes.

alex: link: https://internal/postmortems/kv-oom-2024 (see section 'signals')

drew: I can own the repro/profiling work. Plan: add long-run test in CI, instrument alloc stack traces + heap snapshots. ETA POC by Thu EOD.

sree: I'll take GC tuning + canary rollout. Idea: per-shard soft_limit + smarter eviction thresholds. Will draft config RFC.

maria: I'll own short-term guardrails: per-pod memRequest/limits, kube OOMScore tweaks, and update the OOM runbook + alerts. ETA Wed.

alex: tentative owners: drew (profiling & tests), sree (GC tuning & canary), maria (guardrails & alerts). I'll own tracking and update the postmortem ticket. Please paste one TODO with due date so I can pin.

drew: TODO: add long-run fuzzer + heap snapshot collection to CI; add alloc stacktrace sampling; due 2024-01-12.

sree: TODO: RFC for soft_limit + eviction per-shard, include canary steps and rollback criteria; due 2024-01-16.

maria: TODO: deploy per-pod soft memory limits across staging, add OOM alert thresholds and retention; update PD runbook; due 2024-01-10.

alex: we'll gate config changes behind feature flag `kv_frag_guard`. Add metric `kv.frag_ratio` and dashboard panel in Console (SLO: alarm >0.55).

ops-bot: deploy-bot: Canary deployment queued for kv-cluster-3 (selector: canary=true). Started  — will report status.

drew: watching canary. If kv.frag_ratio > 0.6 or heap growth trend stable for 10m we rollback.

maria: quick snapshot command for teams: `kubectl exec -it kv-<pod> -- /bin/sh -c "curl localhost:8080/debug/heap?format=pprof > /tmp/heap.pb"` — drop into ticket when you take one.

alex: reminder: prefer per-shard eviction/soft-cap over global eviction to avoid cross-shard thrash.

sree: question — any correlation with large-batch inference jobs? I noticed spikes with batch_size>=8.

drew: yes, logs align: small-allocation churn during packer + large-batch RPC spikes. Will add to repro.

maria: we'll add a high-batch scenario to nightly smoke tests and alert on frag_ratio regressions.

alex: reconvene Fri 10:00 for quick sync on progress. I'll update the postmortem ticket with owners and timelines. Thanks all :thumbsup:

sree: thanks — I'll post the RFC draft by tomorrow.

maria: ack, will start setting limits in staging tonight.

ops-bot: deploy-bot: Canary for kv-cluster-3 succeeded — health checks OK. (reported)

alex: great, closing loop for now. Keep updates in the postmortem thread and tag me for unblockers.
